public_rationale: On May 25, 2022, Neyshabur reported that original Imagen could produce the intended scene after a small prompt change [e1]. This supports some capacity to depict a horse riding an astronaut, but it does not locate the original failure in language-to-image mapping or exclude an image-generation limitation [e1]. The claimed causal distinction remains unresolved [e1].
limitations: The demonstration supplies no sample counts, success rates, seeds, or selection procedures [e1].
It provides no controlled test distinguishing language-to-image mapping failures from downstream generation failures [e1].
